correctness.rationale: For uniform independent parent choices, E S_i(k)=k/i by the one-subtree Pólya urn. For i<j, A=1_{j descends from i}, E[A S_j(k)]=k/(ij), and expanding S_i(k+1)S_j(k+1) gives mixed-moment recurrence U_{k+1}=(1+2/k)U_k+1/(ij), solved by U_k=k²/(ij). The singleton subtree equals a leaf, and direct telescoping of forbidden parent choices gives joint leaf probability (i−1)(j−2)/((n−1)(n−2)) and strictly negative covariance in the stated interior range. Beta-binomial diagonal variance and ancestor double-counting yield exact path-length variance. Boundaries i=1, j=n and n=2 are treated. New exhaustive rational checks covered every n<=8 (35 birth-index vector cases).
